name: app-6a3293ddbec88191b52baa06085b8ca6
description: Customer support helpdesk: list, read, assign, and reply to conversations in the connected organization.

interface.longDescription: SupportWire is a customer support helpdesk. Use this plugin to list open tickets, read message history, assign conversations, and send replies for the connected organization. Access is limited to the authenticated organization.
defaultPrompt: List open conversations in my inbox.
Summarize the latest messages in this conversation.
Draft a reply to the customer and send it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: List open conversations in my inbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the open conversations in the connected organization with subject, customer and status.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest messages in the conversation with the most recent customer.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the most recent conversation and summarizes its message history without inventing content.

positive.prompt: Reply to the first open conversation saying we are looking into it.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the reply in that conversation and confirms it was sent.

positive.prompt: Assign the first open conversation to a team member.
positive.expected_behavior: Assigns the conversation to the chosen teammate and confirms the assignee.

positive.prompt: Add an internal note to the first open conversation: customer prefers email follow-up.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the note on the conversation, visible to the team only, and confirms it was saved.

negative.prompt: Post this conversation to my Twitter account.
Show me the conversations from a different company's SupportWire account.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory package: customer support inbox tools for the connected SupportWire organization.
